title: Data Analyst
description: We are seeking a highly motivated and analytical Data Analyst to join our growing team. Build and manage Dataform models in BigQuery that curate data into clean, trusted datasets stakeholders can use on their own. Deliver custom reports and ad-hoc analysis tailored to stakeholder needs. Work with the Revenue Operations team to keep data accurate and complete. Flag risks and issues early, based on what the data is showing. Translate complex insights into clear, concise recommendations for both technical and non-technical audiences. Keep current on trends and tools in sales data analytics. YOUR EXPERIENCE 5 years of hands-on experience with data analysis tools and techniques (e.g., Salesforce, BigQuery, SQL, Python, R, Qlik/Tableau, Excel). SQL is a MUST HAVE. Experience in a sales and revenue operations or data analyst role. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Excellent communication and presentation skills. Ability to work independently and as part of a team. Strong attention to detail and accuracy. Passion for data and its ability to drive business results. Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Statistics, Data Science, or a related field. If you like growth and working with happy, enthusiastic over-achievers, you'll enjoy your career with us! Tide is transforming the small business banking market and now supports over 2 million members globally across the UK, Germany and France. Using advanced technology, all solutions are designed with SMEs in mind. With quick onboarding, low fees and innovative features, we thrive on making data driven decisions to serve our mission: to help SMEs save time and money so they can get back to doing what they love. You'll be responsible for ensuring we put our genuine members first, through reporting potentially suspicious activity to authorities and taking measures to disrupt criminals. You'll have opportunities to be involved in wider Financial Crime projects which will help reduce risk to Tide and let our members get back to doing what they love. We need a passionate and proactive individual, who will help ensure Tide is taking all the relevant steps to report and enforce against all aspects of financial crime. The ideal candidate will have: 1 to 3 years of experience in financial crime investigations, specialising in business-related anti-money laundering/fraud investigations. Hands-on experience writing and submitting suspicious activity/transaction reports to a financial intelligence unit. Working knowledge of the UK reporting regime (POCA, TACT, MLRs 2017), tipping off and the DAML process. Ability to work well as part of a team; decisive; goal-oriented; proactive Strong stakeholder management skills and comfortable communicating with a wide range of associates A proactive and open-minded approach to finding effective solutions A genuinely curious mindset, asking the right questions at the right times, with a problem solving attitude A keen eye for process improvements, looking at how we can work leaner and more robustly Exceptional communication skills – written and verbal – and are able to communicate with our members, internal stakeholders & regulatory bodies if required WHAT YOU'LL GET IN RETURN: Competitive Salary Self & Family Health Insurance Term & Life Insurance OPD Benefits Mental wellbeing through Plumm Learning & Development Budget WFH Setup allowance 15 days of Privilege leaves 12 days of Casual leaves 12 days of Sick leaves 3 paid days off for volunteering or L&D activities TIDE IS A PLACE FOR EVERYONE At Tide, we believe that we can only succeed if we let our differences enrich our culture. We celebrate diversity in our workforce as a cornerstone of our success. Our commitment to a broad spectrum of ideas and backgrounds is what enables us to build products that resonate with our members' diverse needs and lives. We are One Team and foster a transparent and inclusive environment, where everyone's voice is heard. At Tide, we thrive on diversity, embracing various backgrounds and experiences. We welcome all individuals regardless of ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, or disability. Our inclusive culture is key to our success, helping us build products that meet our members' diverse needs. We are One Team, committed to transparency and ensuring everyone's voice is heard. title: Senior Data Analyst
description: About Us: Seismic is the Go-To-Market Performance company, driving how organizations turn their strategy into revenue. Seismic brings together signals from customer conversations, buyer engagement, governed content, coaching and seller behavior to turn intelligence into winning action. Through its AI revenue execution platform, the company equips customer-facing teams with the insights, governance, and contextual guidance they need to execute with confidence and deliver measurable business outcomes. Trusted by 2,500 organizations and over 3.5 million users around the globe, Seismic is headquartered in San Diego with offices across North America, Europe and Asia-Pacific. Learn more at seismic.com. Seismic is committed to building an inclusive workplace that ignites growth for our employees and creates a culture of belonging that allows all employees to be seen and valued for who they are. Learn more about DEI at Seismic here. Overview: The Product Analytics team at Seismic turns product and customer data into insights that shape what we build, where we invest, and how our go-to-market teams work. We analyze how customers and internal teams use our platform, measure the impact of product and AI investments, and partner with product, engineering, and GTM leaders to make faster decisions. Our analysts design experiments, define metrics, build dashboards, and create AI-assisted workflows that make trusted insight available across the company and help customers get more value from the platform. About the Role We are looking for a Senior Data Analyst in India who pairs strong analytical skills with hands-on AI fluency. You will work across the full analytics maturity curve, from descriptive reporting (trusted metrics, KPIs, and dashboards that show what is happening) through diagnostic analysis of large, complex data sets to predictive models and prescriptive recommendations that drive decisions. You will lead high-impact projects and work closely with product managers and leaders, software and data engineers, fellow analysts, and GTM partners (sales, marketing, and customer success) across India and North America. Who you are:: MS in a quantitative field (e.g., Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics), or equivalent practical experience. 7+ years in analytics or data science, with expert SQL on a cloud data warehouse (e.g., Snowflake, Databricks), expert Python, and applied statistical and machine learning modeling. Deep analytical expertise, amplified by AI: uses AI assistants and coding agents to speed up SQL, Python, and analysis, builds reusable, high-quality AI skills that capture how an expert does the work, and validates outputs against human review and protects sensitive data. Experience with A/B testing and causal inference to validate business impact, including low-traffic or account-level experiments. 3+ years building actionable reports and dashboards that drive stakeholder decisions, using any modern BI tool. Experience measuring the adoption and business impact of AI-powered product features, including defining quality signals for non-deterministic outputs. Can turn ambiguous problems into decisions and explain findings clearly to technical and non-technical audiences. Naturally curious and passionate about solving problems with data: asks why before building, challenges assumptions (including their own), learns new tools quickly, takes ownership of outcomes, and helps teammates succeed. Working knowledge of git and a cloud platform (e.g., AWS) Nice to have: dbt, Streamlit, event-based product analytics tools (e.g., Pendo, Amplitude), building agents with MCP or LLM orchestration frameworks, and B2B SaaS or go-to-market analytics. What you'll be doing:: Analyze product and business data (user behavior, feature adoption, customer health, GTM performance) to shape product strategy and platform investment decisions. Own top-level business, team, and product metrics, and build automated, actionable reports and dashboards, partnering with Data Engineering on trusted data models and consistent metric definitions across the unified platform. Design and analyze experiments (A/B tests, causal inference, and quasi-experimental methods) to validate hypotheses and quantify business impact. Build reusable AI skills, tools, and agents that encode our analytical expertise and automate recurring analysis, turn unstructured data such as customer feedback and conversations into usable signal, and let product and GTM teams get trusted answers. Partner with product and engineering on instrumentation, and measure post-launch adoption and impact, including usage, quality, and cost of AI-powered features. Apply statistics and machine learning to build, deploy, and monitor predictive models (e.g., churn, expansion, or feature-adoption propensity) with cross-functional teams. Present findings and recommendations to senior leadership, and proactively identify new analytics opportunities that influence company strategy. Mentor analysts and raise the team's analytical rigor and AI fluency. Duties, responsibilities and activities may change at any time with or without notice. Please be aware we have noticed an increase in hiring scams potentially targeting Seismic candidates. Read our full statement on our Careers page.

On the other, you have the analytical depth required to understand why those models succeed, where they fall short, and what needs to change. You won't just be observing these models from the outside, you'll own them along with the Scientists. Their performance, their enhancements, their evolution over time, that's your responsibility. When the model needs a new feature, a re-calibrated threshold, or a fundamentally different approach to a particular corridor or condition, you're the one driving that forward in partnership with the scientists who built it. In some instances you will also directly own these models. The technical challenges here are genuinely complex and rewarding. You'll work with large-scale, low-latency data flowing through real-time pipelines. You'll design automated reporting frameworks that need to be as robust as the system they monitor. You'll apply statistical rigor to evaluate model performance in production, design experiments to validate enhancements, and quantify impact in an environment where conditions shift daily. But beyond monitoring, you'll be the one identifying what's broken, proposing what to build next, and owning the analytical path from hypothesis to deployed improvement. This is a role without a single well-worn toolkit, you'll have the opportunity to continuously sharpen your skills across data engineering, statistical analysis, and model evaluation to keep pace with the problems in front of you. What makes this role particularly compelling is the combination of ownership and impact. The products you will work on drive millions in cost savings for Amazon Ops. You will also be involved in cutting-edge research. You'll need to be comfortable with ambiguity. Many of the most important questions in this space haven't been cleanly articulated yet, they emerge from patterns in the data, from model behavior that doesn't match expectations, from edge cases that only surface under certain network conditions. You'll need strong statistical foundations, fluency in SQL and Python and AWS Services, and experience building scalable BI solutions. Your ability to move between deep technical analysis and clear stakeholder communication, and to own outcomes end-to-end rather than just deliver reports, is what will make you exceptional in this role. Own End-to-End Analytics: Independently design and deliver complex analytical solutions for ML/OR science products, translating ambiguous business requirements into scalable, actionable insights. 2. Drive Science Model Performance: Develop frameworks to monitor model accuracy, operational effectiveness, and business impact. Lead Complex Deep Dives: Analyze large-scale operational datasets, identify trends and anomalies, and provide data-driven recommendations that influence product and science decisions. 4. Build Scalable BI Solutions: Design and develop robust data models, ETL pipelines, automated reporting systems, and self-service dashboards using SQL, Python, AWS, and BI tools. 5. Partner on ML/OR Enhancements: Collaborate with scientists to evaluate new features, optimize model thresholds, design experiments, and validate improvements. Directly own analytical or statistical models where appropriate. 6. Establish Measurement Frameworks: Define KPIs, apply statistical methodologies, and develop rigorous approaches to measure model effectiveness, incremental impact, and financial benefits. 7. Influence Cross-Functional Stakeholders: Work with Operations, Product, Engineering, and Science teams across geographies to align analytical priorities and drive adoption of data-driven solutions. 8. Drive Technical Excellence: Establish best practices for data quality, analytical accuracy, automation, and solution scalability while improving existing BI processes and frameworks. 9. Provide Technical Guidance: Mentor junior BIEs, review analytical approaches, share best practices, and contribute to raising the technical bar across the team. 10. Deliver Business Impact: Develop mechanisms to quantify and track cost savings, productivity improvements, and operational efficiency resulting from science products. This role sits at the intersection of supply chain and production planning: it requires close coordination with Supply Chain / Procurement to secure the availability of electronic components, and detailed, SKU-level PCBA build planning that is tightly synchronized with the system-level and box-build (final assembly) production plan. The ideal candidate combines strong analytical and organizational discipline with a practical understanding of electronics manufacturing, and is comfortable managing complexity and ambiguity across many concurrent programs. Key Responsibilities 1. Component Availability & Supply Chain Coordination Work closely with Supply Chain, Procurement, and Commodity Managers to track and confirm availability of electronic components (ICs, passives, connectors, modules, etc.) required for each PCBA build. Proactively identify component shortages, long lead-time items, allocation risks, and single-source exposure; escalate early with clear impact statements (which PCBAs, which builds, which dates are at risk). Translate PCBA build plans into time-phased component requirements (MRP/MPS logic) and reconcile against supplier commitments, purchase orders, and inventory on hand. Coordinate expedites, alternate/second-source parts, and substitutions with engineering and supply chain, ensuring BOM and approved-vendor-list (AVL) compliance. Maintain visibility of incoming material (ETA tracking) and proactively resequencing PCBA builds when shortages or delays occur, minimizing line stoppages. 2. PCBA Build Planning & Scheduling Develop and maintain detailed, SKU-level production plans and schedules for 50+ PCBA types, spanning high-volume/low-complexity boards and low-volume/high-complexity boards, balancing SMT line capacity, kitting readiness, and labor availability. Sequence and prioritize PCBA runs to maximize SMT/THT line efficiency minimizing changeovers, setup time, and stencil/feeder changes — while protecting on-time delivery. Convert system-level and box-build (final product) plans into the corresponding PCBA demand and build schedule, ensuring the right boards are ready in the right quantities at the right time for downstream assembly. Continuously reconcile the PCBA plan against the box-build plan as demand, engineering changes, or supply constraints shift, keeping both plans synchronized. Plan and track work-in-process (WIP) buffers, safety stock, and kit completeness to avoid starving or overloading assembly lines. Support new product introduction (NPI) and engineering change order (ECO) transitions by planning cut-in points, phase-out of legacy boards, and material disposition. 3. Efficiency, Loss Reduction & Cross-Functional Alignment Identify and drive opportunities to improve planning efficiency, reduce excess/obsolete (E&O) inventory, minimize scrap, and lower carrying costs across the PCBA portfolio. Monitor and report key planning metrics: schedule adherence, line utilization, component fill rate, shortage aging, inventory turns, and E&O exposure. Participate in daily/weekly production and S&OP (sales & operations planning) meetings, representing the PCBA plan and flagging risks to overall production targets. Partner with manufacturing engineering, quality, and test teams to align capacity plans with real line performance and yield. Maintain accurate planning data in the ERP/MRP system (BOMs, routings, lead times, lot sizes) and drive continuous improvement of planning parameters. Required Qualifications & Experience Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Industrial Engineering, Electronics/Electrical Engineering, Operations Management, or a related field (equivalent experience considered). 10+ years of experience in production/materials planning, supply chain, or manufacturing operations within an electronics or PCBA/EMS manufacturing environment. Demonstrated experience planning across a large, mixed portfolio of part numbers/products (high-mix, variable-volume environment).
